signals.text: 1 new PM role posted this week

bullets: Own the Web Attribution product end-to-end, from discovery and strategy to execution, launch, adoption and continuous improvement.
Define and drive the roadmap for web performance measurement: attribution of any channel to web conversions (clicks, views, CTV and more), multi-touch, web analytics and…
Lead in a privacy-first world: build durable measurement as cookies, identifiers and browser rules keep changing, through first-party data, probabilistic and modeled approaches…
Work closely with R&D (Backend, Frontend, Data Engineering, Data Science) to build scalable, high-performance measurement products.
Work with ad networks and platform partners to build and expand web integrations, bringing mobile-grade measurement to the web: granular, independent attribution and conversion…
